propositions: Step-budget exhaustion raises LLMRunnerError but CompletionAgentStep.run only catches UnretryableOutputError, preventing bounded completion recovery from being invoked
LLMRunnerError is a strict ancestor of UnretryableOutputError, so budget exhaustion exceptions never match the existing except clause despite being the recovery's intended failure case
Bounded completion recovery mechanism isolates criteria in fresh agentic history and converges evidence runs, but is unreachable for budget-exhaustion errors due to exception type mismatch
A new LLMBudgetExhaustedError subclass of LLMRunnerError must be introduced and raised from interpret_failure's budget branch to make the error type identifiable without message or shape sniffing
CompletionAgentStep.run's except clause must be extended to catch LLMBudgetExhaustedError and route it to _recover, preserving the budget diagnostic for downstream failure reporting
